canonical.status: decided, not implemented in this repo
canonical.decision: This Astro build will replace the site currently live at https://amoeba.design. Launch and canonical origin is https://amoeba.design. https://amoeba-design.vercel.app remains the current pre-launch deploy URL.
canonical.code: astro.config.mjs does not set site. src/layouts/Base.astro does not emit a canonical link. There is no vercel.json. The package.json name amoeba.design is the npm package name, not a canonical URL. On 2026-10-10, https://amoeba-design.vercel.app/ returned HTTP 200 with no Location redirect to https://amoeba.design.
canonical.legacySite: https://amoeba.design currently serves a different Next.js app. That app emits its own canonical to https://amoeba.design. It is the site this build will replace, not this repo's output.
